tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[A pair without the homotopy extension property] ↗ prop:hep-iff-retract \group CW Complexes

Let $A=\{ 0,1,1/2,1/4,1/3,\ldots \} \subset I$. Although $A$ is closed, $(I,A)$ does not have HEP: there is no retraction $I\times I\to I\times \{ 0\} \cup A\times I$. \end{example}
